research.title:
Understand the work.
Then rethink how it gets done.
research.intro: WORK 16 is an evolving research project grounded in what people actually do, before asking where AI can help.
research.methodBody: Work science: understand the work. Work engineering: develop methods. Work business: organise delivery.
research.original: The full manuscript and practice tools are available in their original Chinese edition.
about.intro: Explore contemporary philosophy across six shelves, one book at a time.
workstation.title: Super Workstation Architecture
workstation.intro: Select a market or a node to explore how the workstation connects the content, leads and sales, and delivery engines. Scroll sideways to see the full diagram. The interactive map is in Chinese.
hero.support.problem: The team can’t keep up with incoming questions
hero.support.method: Group common questions, connect a knowledge base, and define when a person takes over.
hero.support.result: A support workflow to pilot, with answers for common questions, human escalation, and a follow-up log.
hero.research.problem: We’re considering a new market, but the evidence is scattered
hero.research.method: Define the decision, verify sources, and compare options using the same criteria.
hero.research.result: A decision brief with options, source links, and assumptions to test.
hero.office.problem: The meeting ended without clear owners for the next steps
hero.office.method: Extract decisions and actions, confirm owners and deadlines, then update the shared tracker.
hero.office.result: An action tracker showing who owns each task, when it’s due, and where it stands.
journal.intro: A contemporary philosophy reading list organized by language, with a few optional classics. Open a poster to see the original Chinese reading notes and a prompt.
journal.routine: Read the second alongside the first, then follow your interests. Set aside 20–30 minutes a day.
journal.prompt: Which line stayed with you today? Write a sentence or two about how it connects to your life.

hero.boss.problem: We want to use AI, but the team doesn’t know where to start
hero.boss.method: Choose a pilot with the leader, then define ownership and acceptance criteria
